name: Advanced process control and model predictive control
aliases: Advanced process control and model predictive control
applications: chemical plants and oil refineries since the 1980s
principle: MPC uses a process model to optimise the current step while accounting for future steps and constraints. Only the first step is applied; then the controller resamples and repeats.

process_steps.name: Optimise control moves over a short horizon

advantages: Anticipates future events, which PID controllers cannot
limitations: Complexity is usually unnecessary for simple systems
Nonlinear MPC problems may not be convex
